sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate is a verified canonical method-use or applicability concept/path for the optional in-lieu calculation or model-test method; the evidence and approval candidates do not satisfy that applicability obligation.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Although deterministic validation is valid, repair the semantic logic: do not make this optional in-lieu approval pathway mandatory for every ship targeted by sh:targetClass nltl:ship; constrain it to an individual ship using the alternative Ke/RCH method, without inventing a convenience applicability boolean. Ensure approvalRevocationStatus cannot be Draft, Submitted, UnderReview, Rejected, or Expired while approvalStatus is true; the current independent requirements allow an approved=true ship with a rejected or otherwise non-approved state to pass. Restrict the status semantics to the verified approval/revocation states and encode their consistency, while retaining the required alternative-calculation/model-test evidence and at least one Ke or RCH result. Do not add shipPerformanceExperienceEvidence, because the COMPLETE dependency contract explicitly removes that nonmandatory evidence obligation.

Repair the applicability and target logic. Do not target every ship that happens to have any one evidence or result, then make the alternative-method evidence, approval/status, and Ke-or-RCH result obligations mandatory for that target set. Constrain the shape to an individual ship actually using the optional in-lieu method, with the required alternative-calculation or model-test evidence and at least one Ke or RCH result; do not invent an applicability boolean. Preserve both result alternatives and their declared units, and retain the approvalStatus/approvalRevocationStatus consistency rule so approvalStatus true requires evidenceStateApproved. The deterministic graph is structurally valid, but its broad OR-based SPARQL target creates accidental applicability and imposes the pathway on ships not established as using it.

Repair the applicability target: the current SPARQL target uses an OR between evidence and Ke/RCH, so it targets ships not established as using the optional in-lieu method and then imposes all pathway obligations on them. Constrain it to an individual ship with the canonical method-use/applicability concept or path; no convenience boolean is permitted, so locate the missing canonical term/path. Require the relevant evidence and at least one Ke or RCH result with AND semantics. Do not apply the alternative-evidence class constraint to every hasEvidence value: use a qualified value shape/minimum so one qualifying alternativeCalculationEvidence or modelTestEvidence artifact suffices without rejecting unrelated evidence. Preserve the ship-owned approvalStatus and approvalRevocationStatus, the approved-state consistency check when approvalStatus is true, both Ke/RCH alternatives, their declared units, and the removal of nonmandatory ship-performance-experience evidence.
